Step 1: Helper functions
```{r}
safe_auc <- function(y_true, probs) {
  if (length(unique(y_true)) < 2) return(NA_real_)
  as.numeric(pROC::auc(y_true, probs))
}

safe_pr_auc <- function(y_true, probs) {
  pos <- probs[y_true == 1]
  neg <- probs[y_true == 0]
  if (length(pos) == 0 || length(neg) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  pr <- PRROC::pr.curve(scores.class0 = pos, scores.class1 = neg, curve = FALSE)
  as.numeric(pr$auc.integral)
}

calc_metrics <- function(y_true, probs, threshold = 0.5) {
  pred <- ifelse(probs >= threshold, 1, 0)

  cm <- table(
    factor(pred, levels = c(0,1)),
    factor(y_true, levels = c(0,1))
  )

  TN <- cm[1,1]
  FN <- cm[1,2]
  FP <- cm[2,1]
  TP <- cm[2,2]

  precision <- ifelse((TP + FP) == 0, 0, TP / (TP + FP))
  recall    <- ifelse((TP + FN) == 0, 0, TP / (TP + FN))
  f1        <- ifelse((precision + recall) == 0, 0,
                      2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall))
  accuracy  <- (TP + TN) / sum(cm)
  specificity <- ifelse((TN + FP) == 0, 0, TN / (TN + FP))
  bal_acc <- (recall + specificity) / 2

  tibble(
    Accuracy = accuracy,
    Precision = precision,
    Recall = recall,
    F1 = f1,
    Specificity = specificity,
    BalancedAccuracy = bal_acc,
    AUC_ROC = safe_auc(y_true, probs),
    AUC_PR = safe_pr_auc(y_true, probs)
  )
}

find_best_threshold <- function(y_true, probs) {
  thresholds <- seq(0.05, 0.95, by = 0.01)

  results <- map_dfr(thresholds, function(t) {
    calc_metrics(y_true, probs, threshold = t) %>%
      mutate(Threshold = t, .before = 1)
  })

  best <- results %>%
    arrange(desc(F1), desc(Recall), desc(Precision)) %>%
    slice(1)

  list(best_threshold = best$Threshold, full_table = results, best_row = best)
}

brier_score <- function(y_true, probs) {
  mean((probs - y_true)^2)
}

q_stat <- function(pred1, pred2, y_true, thr = 0.5) {
  
  # Remove NA values first (CRITICAL)
  valid_idx <- which(!is.na(pred1) & !is.na(pred2) & !is.na(y_true))
  
  pred1 <- pred1[valid_idx]
  pred2 <- pred2[valid_idx]
  y_true <- y_true[valid_idx]
  
  # Convert to binary
  p1 <- ifelse(pred1 >= thr, 1, 0)
  p2 <- ifelse(pred2 >= thr, 1, 0)
  
  c1 <- (p1 == y_true)
  c2 <- (p2 == y_true)
  
  N11 <- sum(c1 & c2, na.rm = TRUE)
  N00 <- sum(!c1 & !c2, na.rm = TRUE)
  N10 <- sum(c1 & !c2, na.rm = TRUE)
  N01 <- sum(!c1 & c2, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  denom <- (N11 * N00 + N10 * N01)
  
  # 🔥 FIX: handle NA OR zero denominator
  if (is.na(denom) || denom == 0) return(NA_real_)
  
  (N11 * N00 - N10 * N01) / denom

}
```

```{r}

df_original  <- read.csv("C:/Users/USER/Desktop/data_set_2_kaggle.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
```

Step 3: Alignment checks
```{r}
stopifnot(length(xgb_oof)  == nrow(df_original))

stopifnot(length(y_full)   == nrow(df_original))

meta_df <- data.frame(
  ClaimID = df_original$ClaimID,
  FraudFound = y_full,
  PXGB = as.numeric(xgb_oof),
  PLSTM = as.numeric(lstm_oof),
  PGNN = as.numeric(gnn_oof)
)

cat("Rows before NA removal:", nrow(meta_df), "\n")

meta_df <- meta_df %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(FraudFound),
    !is.na(PXGB),
    !is.na(PLSTM),
    !is.na(PGNN)
  )

cat("Rows after NA removal:", nrow(meta_df), "\n")
```

Step 5: Correlation and diversity analysis
```{r}
cor_matrix <- cor(meta_df[, c("PXGB", "PLSTM", "PGNN")])
print(cor_matrix)

corrplot(cor_matrix, method = "number", type = "upper", tl.col = "black")

q_results <- tibble(
  Pair = c("XGB-LSTM", "XGB-GNN", "LSTM-GNN"),
  Q_Statistic = c(

    q_stat(meta_df$PXGB, meta_df$PGNN, meta_df$FraudFound),

  )
)

```

Step 6: Train-test split at meta level
```{r}
set.seed(42)

train_idx <- createDataPartition(meta_df$FraudFound, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)

train_df <- meta_df[train_idx, ]
test_df  <- meta_df[-train_idx, ]

cat("Meta-train rows:", nrow(train_df), "\n")
cat("Meta-test rows:", nrow(test_df), "\n")
```

Step 7: Train meta-learners

A) Primary model: Logistic Regression
```{r}
meta_glm <- glm(
  FraudFound ~ PXGB + PLSTM + PGNN,
  data = train_df,
  family = binomial()
)

summary(meta_glm)

coef_table <- broom::tidy(meta_glm) %>%
  mutate(OddsRatio = exp(estimate))

coef_table
```

B) Alternative model: Random Forest
```{r}
meta_rf <- randomForest(
  x = train_df[, c("PXGB", "PLSTM", "PGNN")],
  y = factor(train_df$FraudFound),
  ntree = 500,
  mtry = 2,
  importance = TRUE
)

print(meta_rf)
importance(meta_rf)
```

C) Alternative model: XGBoost meta-learner
```{r}
dtrain_meta <- xgb.DMatrix(
  data = as.matrix(train_df[, c("PXGB", "PLSTM", "PGNN")]),
  label = train_df$FraudFound
)

params_meta <- list(
  objective = "binary:logistic",
  eval_metric = "aucpr",
  eta = 0.05,
  max_depth = 2,
  subsample = 0.8,
  colsample_bytree = 0.8,
  min_child_weight = 2
)

meta_xgb <- xgb.train(
  params = params_meta,
  data = dtrain_meta,
  nrounds = 100,
  verbose = 0
)

```

Step 8: Weighted average benchmark
```{r}
weight_grid <- expand.grid(
  w1 = seq(0, 1, by = 0.05),
  w2 = seq(0, 1, by = 0.05)
) %>%
  mutate(w3 = 1 - w1 - w2) %>%
  filter(w3 >= 0)

weight_grid$AUC_PR <- pmap_dbl(
  list(weight_grid$w1, weight_grid$w2, weight_grid$w3),
  function(w1, w2, w3) {
    probs <- w1 * train_df$PXGB + w2 * train_df$PLSTM + w3 * train_df$PGNN
    safe_pr_auc(train_df$FraudFound, probs)
  }
)

best_weights <- weight_grid %>%
  arrange(desc(AUC_PR)) %>%
  slice(1)

print(best_weights)
```

Step 9: Predict on meta test set
```{r}
test_preds <- test_df %>%
  transmute(
    ClaimID,
    FraudFound,
    PXGB,
    PLSTM,
    PGNN,
    LogisticStack = predict(meta_glm, newdata = test_df, type = "response"),
    RandomForestStack = predict(meta_rf, newdata = test_df[, c("PXGB", "PLSTM", "PGNN")],
                                type = "prob")[,2],
    XGBoostStack = predict(
      meta_xgb,
      newdata = xgb.DMatrix(as.matrix(test_df[, c("PXGB", "PLSTM", "PGNN")]))
    ),
    WeightedAverage = best_weights$w1 * PXGB + best_weights$w2 * PLSTM + best_weights$w3 * PGNN,
    SimpleAverage = (PXGB + PLSTM + PGNN) / 3
  )

head(test_preds)
```

```{r}
threshold_info$best_row
```

Step 11: Evaluate all models
```{r}
model_names <- c(
  "PXGB", "PLSTM", "PGNN",
  "LogisticStack", "RandomForestStack", "XGBoostStack",
  "WeightedAverage", "SimpleAverage"
)

evaluation_results <- map_dfr(model_names, function(m) {
  threshold_to_use <- ifelse(m == "LogisticStack", best_threshold, 0.5)

  calc_metrics(
    y_true = test_preds$FraudFound,
    probs = test_preds[[m]],
    threshold = threshold_to_use
  ) %>%
    mutate(Model = m, .before = 1)
})

evaluation_results %>%
  arrange(desc(AUC_PR), desc(Recall), desc(F1))
```

Step 12: ROC and PR curves
```{r}
# ROC
roc_list <- lapply(model_names, function(m) {
  roc(test_preds$FraudFound, test_preds[[m]], quiet = TRUE)
})
names(roc_list) <- model_names

plot(roc_list[[1]], main = "ROC Curves - Meta Learner Comparison")
for (i in 2:length(roc_list)) {
  plot(roc_list[[i]], add = TRUE)
}
legend("bottomright", legend = model_names, cex = 0.7)

# PR
plot(NULL, xlim = c(0,1), ylim = c(0,1),
     xlab = "Recall", ylab = "Precision",
     main = "Precision-Recall Curves - Meta Learner Comparison")

for (m in model_names) {
  pos <- test_preds[[m]][test_preds$FraudFound == 1]
  neg <- test_preds[[m]][test_preds$FraudFound == 0]
  pr <- pr.curve(scores.class0 = pos, scores.class1 = neg, curve = TRUE)
  lines(pr$curve[,1], pr$curve[,2])
}
legend("topright", legend = model_names, cex = 0.7)
```

Step 14: Statistical comparison
```{r}
base_results <- evaluation_results %>%
  filter(Model %in% c("PXGB", "PLSTM", "PGNN")) %>%
  arrange(desc(AUC_PR), desc(Recall), desc(F1))

best_base <- base_results$Model[1]
cat("Best base model:", best_base, "\n")

roc_stack <- roc(test_preds$FraudFound, test_preds$LogisticStack, quiet = TRUE)
roc_base  <- roc(test_preds$FraudFound, test_preds[[best_base]], quiet = TRUE)

delong_test <- roc.test(roc_stack, roc_base, method = "delong")
print(delong_test)

```

Step 15: Ablation analysis
```{r}
fit_ablation <- function(train_df, test_df, features) {
  form <- as.formula(
    paste("FraudFound ~", paste(features, collapse = " + "))
  )

  model <- glm(form, data = train_df, family = binomial())

  train_probs <- predict(model, newdata = train_df, type = "response")
  best_thr <- find_best_threshold(train_df$FraudFound, train_probs)$best_threshold

  test_probs <- predict(model, newdata = test_df, type = "response")

  calc_metrics(test_df$FraudFound, test_probs, threshold = best_thr) %>%
    mutate(Features = paste(features, collapse = " + "), .before = 1)
}

ablation_results <- bind_rows(
  fit_ablation(train_df, test_df, c("PXGB", "PLSTM")),
  fit_ablation(train_df, test_df, c("PXGB", "PGNN")),
  fit_ablation(train_df, test_df, c("PLSTM", "PGNN")),
  fit_ablation(train_df, test_df, c("PXGB", "PLSTM", "PGNN"))
)

ablation_results %>%
  arrange(desc(AUC_PR), desc(Recall), desc(F1))
```
